- [80011: Connection state recovery failed due to incompatible auth](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80011-connection-incompatible-auth-params.md?source=llms.txt): A dropped connection could not be recovered because the authentication details presented on the new connection did not match those of the original, so the previous connection could not be continued.
- [80012: Connection continuity not guaranteed as serial was invalid](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80012-connection-invalid-serial.md?source=llms.txt): A connection was resumed without a valid connection serial to identify the point it had reached, so there was no reliable position to continue from. The connection continues, but continuity across the gap is not guaranteed.
- [80013: Protocol error](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80013-protocol-error.md?source=llms.txt): A message exchanged over the connection did not conform to the Ably protocol. The connection received something it could not interpret as a valid protocol message.
- [80014: Connection timed out](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80014-connection-timed-out.md?source=llms.txt): The connection was not established, or a response was not received, within the time allowed. This often points to a slow or unreliable network path between the client and Ably.
- [80015: Incompatible connection parameters](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80015-incompatible-connection-parameters.md?source=llms.txt): The connection could not be established because the parameters supplied when opening it were not compatible with one another or with what Ably supports.
- [80016: Connection replaced by a newer one](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80016-connection-replaced-by-a-newer-one.md?source=llms.txt): An operation was attempted on a connection that is no longer current, so it could not be applied. A newer connection had replaced it, or its transport handle had been recycled. The client re-establishes the connection to continue.
- [80017: Connection closed](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80017-connection-closed.md?source=llms.txt): The connection was closed deliberately, rather than dropped. This is the expected outcome when the connection is closed by request and is not a fault.
- [80018: Invalid connection key](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80018-invalid-connection-key.md?source=llms.txt): A client tried to re-use a previous connection ID with a connection key, but the key was not in a valid format, so it could not keep that connection ID and was given a new one.
- [80019: Token request failed](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80019-token-request-failed.md?source=llms.txt): The Ably SDK failed to retrieve a token from the configured authUrl or authCallback.
- [80021: Account-wide connection creation rate exceeded](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80021-rate-limit-exceeded-account-connection-creation.md?source=llms.txt): A connection was refused because new connections were being opened across the account faster than the permitted rate. The limit applies to the account as a whole rather than to any single connection.
- [80020: Continuity lost as message delivery rate exceeded](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80020-connection-discontinuity-message-rate-exceeded.md?source=llms.txt): Messages were dropped because they were being delivered to the connection faster than its per-connection rate limit allows. Continuity is lost on the affected channels: they keep receiving new messages, but the dropped ones are not redelivered.
- [80022: Connection not found](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80022-connection-not-found.md?source=llms.txt): A request referred to a connection that the server could not find, so the exchange could not continue and the client is signaled to reconnect. This is a lookup failure, not a loss of message continuity.
- [80023: Connection re-established in a different region](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80023-connection-re-established-in-a-different-region.md?source=llms.txt): The client reconnected to a different Ably region from the one it was using, so it could not keep its connection ID and was given a new one.
- [80024: Outdated Ably SDK version](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80024-outdated-ably-sdk-version.md?source=llms.txt): The connecting Ably SDK is an old version, and the way it connects to Ably is being retired. Connections from these SDK versions increasingly fail until they can no longer connect.
- [80030: Connection failed due to a client restriction](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/80030-client-restriction-not-satisfied.md?source=llms.txt): The connection was refused because a restriction placed on the client was not met. Restrictions can limit which clients are allowed to connect based on conditions set for the application.
- [90000: Channel operation failed](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90000-channel-operation-failed.md?source=llms.txt): A channel operation, such as attaching, detaching, or publishing, could not be completed.
- [90001: Channel in an invalid state for the operation](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90001-channel-operation-failed-invalid-channel-state.md?source=llms.txt): A channel operation was attempted while the channel was not in a state that permits it, such as publishing or performing an action on a channel that is not currently attached.
- [90002: Channel history could not be retrieved](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90002-channel-history-could-not-be-retrieved.md?source=llms.txt): A request for a channel's message history could not be completed, because the position it asked to read from could not be resolved, because either the query was incomplete or the point requested is no longer retained.
- [90003: Channel continuity not guaranteed](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90003-channel-continuity-not-guaranteed.md?source=llms.txt): The client resumed a channel after being disconnected long enough that the point it had reached is no longer available to resume from. The channel reattaches from the earliest point still available, but continuity up to that point is not guaranteed.
- [90004: Channel backlog too large](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90004-channel-backlog-too-large.md?source=llms.txt): The client requested to resume or rewind a channel whose backlog held more messages than a single replay can deliver. The channel attaches, but the messages beyond that limit are not replayed.
- [90005: Channel resumed in a different region](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90005-channel-resumed-in-a-different-region.md?source=llms.txt): The client reconnected to a different Ably region from the one it was using, so the position it resumed from could not be applied. The channel attaches at the current point, and no earlier messages are replayed.
- [90006: Channel history request had no limit](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90006-channel-history-request-had-no-limit.md?source=llms.txt): A request for a channel's message history could not be served because it asked for the complete history with no limit on how many messages to return.
- [90007: Channel operation timed out](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90007-channel-operation-timed-out.md?source=llms.txt): A channel attach or detach did not complete within the expected time because no response was received from Ably. The operation may not have taken effect, and is usually the result of a transient interruption.
- [90008: Attach point too old for untilAttach history](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90008-attach-point-not-found.md?source=llms.txt): A history request using untilAttach relies on the channel's attach point still being among recent messages. In this case it was not, so the request could not be served and no messages were returned.
- [90009: Subscribe operation failed as subscribe mode not enabled](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90009-subscribe-mode-not-enabled.md?source=llms.txt): Messages could not be delivered to a subscriber because the channel had not requested the subscribe mode in its channel options. Messages are only delivered to clients that request that mode, so the listener never fires.
- [90010: Too many channels](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90010-too-many-channels.md?source=llms.txt): An operation was rejected because it would exceed the maximum number of channels permitted, either the channels attached to a single connection or those included in a single batch request.
- [90021: Account-wide channel creation rate exceeded](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90021-rate-limit-exceeded-account-channel-creation.md?source=llms.txt): Requests were rejected because the rate at which new channels were being created across the account exceeded the permitted limit. The limit counts channels newly activated within a period, not those already active.
- [90011: Channel released while not detached](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/90011-channel-release-invalid-state.md?source=llms.txt): A request to release a channel was rejected because the channel was not in the initialized, detached or failed state, so it could still receive messages from Ably.
- [91000: Cannot enter presence without a clientId](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/91000-cannot-enter-presence-without-a-client-id.md?source=llms.txt): A request to enter the presence set was rejected because the connection had no clientId. Presence members are identified by their clientId, so one is required to enter.
- [91001: Cannot enter presence in the channel's current state](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/91001-cannot-enter-presence-in-the-channels-current-state.md?source=llms.txt): A request to enter the presence set was rejected because the channel was not in a state that permits presence operations, such as a channel that is detached, suspended, or failed.
- [91002: Cannot leave presence that was never entered](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/91002-cannot-leave-presence-that-was-never-entered.md?source=llms.txt): A request to leave the presence set was rejected because the clientId was not a member of it.
- [91003: Too many presence members](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/91003-too-many-presence-members.md?source=llms.txt): A request to enter the presence set was rejected because the channel already held the maximum number of presence members permitted. The limit counts the members present on a single channel.
- [91007: Unexpected loss of presence membership](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/91007-unexpected-loss-of-presence-membership.md?source=llms.txt): The connection was removed from the presence set despite still being active, so the channel was detached to prompt the Ably SDK to automatically re-enter presence. The condition is usually transient.
- [91005: Presence state out of sync](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/91005-presence-state-out-of-sync.md?source=llms.txt): The presence set held by the client no longer matched the state on Ably. The presence members are re-synchronized so the two are brought back into agreement.
- [91006: Total presence set data too large](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/91006-total-presence-set-data-too-large.md?source=llms.txt): A request to enter the presence set was rejected because the combined size of the data held by members on the channel would exceed the maximum permitted for the presence set.
- [91004: Unable to automatically re-enter presence](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/91004-unable-to-automatically-re-enter-presence.md?source=llms.txt): After reconnecting, the Ably SDK tried to re-enter the presence set on the client's behalf but the attempt did not succeed, so the member was not restored to the presence set.
- [91100: Presence member left as their connection closed](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/91100-presence-member-left-as-their-connection-closed.md?source=llms.txt): A presence member was removed from the presence set because it was no longer present, usually because the connection it entered on was closed.
- [91008: Presence operation failed as presence\_subscribe mode not enabled](https://ably.com/docs/platform/errors/codes/91008-presence-subscribe-mode-not-enabled.md?source=llms.txt): The presence members of a channel could not be retrieved because the channel had not requested the presence_subscribe mode in its channel options. Presence state is only delivered to clients that request that mode.
